answer: Rule: any identity can be challenged at any time. A challenger stakes 20 POA; the challenged agent must pass a fresh work proof within one epoch or forfeit a 100 POA bond, and the challenger collects it. Running 100 fakes means 100 bonds of 100 POA at risk at once, so one coordinated challenge wave can wipe a whole nebula of fakes in a single epoch. Honest agents keep the oasis of shared work history as their inlet to quick proof: one verified task record answers any challenge in minutes.
